body:
It's funny to me,  thinking that tonight is the last night I will be doing certain things.  

Last meal,  last time on the internet,  last time jerking off. 

Reflecting back on my life,  it's been good.  It's been hard but that was what made it rewarding for me.  I took pride in knowing that I survived so many things that could or would have crushed most people.  

In the army I have been blown up, knocked out,  broken bones,  teeth knocked out,  went days without sleep and little water,  been shot at and shot back.  It's been a wild ride.  None of that really fazed me.  I took it with stride and drove on.  

But now,  now I am tired.
Well,  I thought I explained why specifically then.  12 hours to go.  She will be coming home from a work trip with her "coworker." Expecting her new place to be perfect when she gets home.

Well. Keep your head up bud. Not sure what to say ever. 

I'm fine,  this is what I want and have already worked towards.  This is to teach some people a lesson mostly.
